subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配体分类：下列配体属于哪一种 L/X 类型：allyl (η³)（η³-C₃H₅）？
A. LX
B. L₂X
C. LX₂
D. X₂
explanation: η³-C₃H₅ (allyl (η³)) is an LX ligand: each L gives 2 electrons and each X one, so 3 electrons in the covalent count (4 in the ionic count).
